blocks.value: Key Aspects of CEED Entrance Examinations
The following are the key aspects of the IIT CEED Entrance Examination:
1. Aim: CEED is conducted to check and evaluate the aptitude for design and creativity for the M.Des Programme .
2. Eligibility: It requires a Bachelor's degree.
3. Application: The application for CEED started on October 01, 2025 and ended on November 07, 2025.
4. Examination: The CEED Examination was held on January 18, 2026.
5. Negative Marking: There is negative marking in Part A.
6. CEED Score Acceptance: The score is accepted by almost all the IITs and other design institutes for M.Des Admission.
What's Next After the CEED Entrance Exam?

After the CEED Entrance Exam, the results are announced on the official website. Candidates are then required to apply individually to the institutions of their choice using the CEED Score card. Each Institute will have a separate application process, portfolio review, interview rounds, etc. CEED does not conduct any joint counselling for the shortlisted candidates. Counselling is done by individual institutions.

blocks.value: Result of CEED 2026 is prepared by giving weightage to CEED Part A and Part B. Part A will carry 25% marks. Part B will carry 75% marks. Final score is calculated using a formula.
CEED Final Score = 0.25 x Marks obtained in Part A + 0.75 x Marks obtained in Part B.
CEED result will be out on March 04, 2026 on the website.

The CEED score is valid for a period of one year from the date of declaration of the result. This means you can use CEED 2026 scores for admission in the current academic session only. You can't use for admission in the next year.
Likewise, you can't use CEED 2025 scores for admission in the upcoming session.
IIT Bombay is exam conducting body for CEED 2026. The institute, however, doesn’t prescribed any study material for the exam.

CEED Counselling 2026

CEED counselling registration form is expected to open in the third week of March 2026 . IIT Bombay will not conduct any Joint Seat Allotment for CEED 2026 qualified candidates. Instead, the participating institutes of CEED 2026 will conduct counselling at an institute level. Candidates who are assigned a merit rank in CEED 2026 will have to apply directly to the relevant institute through their admission portal.

To apply for admission, the candidate has to go to the admission portal of the CEED 2026 participating institute and fill in counselling registration form and upload their CEED 2026 scorecards and any relevant documents .

The participating institutes will shortlist candidates based on their CEED 2026 merit ranks and may conduct further admission rounds, including personal interviews. The seat allotment will be based on the final merit rank prepared by the institute.

Note : In addition to the participating institutes, CEED 2026 scores will also be accepted by institutes like the World University of Design (WUD) to fill UG and PG seats. Applicants can apply to these institutes as the CEED 2026 results are announced.

How to Prepare for IIT CEED 2026
The CEED 2026 question paper is designed to evaluate the visual perception, creativity, drawing skills, logical reasoning and communication skills of the candidate.
Tips to prepare for the IIT CEED 2026 entrance exam is given below.

value: Prepare a Daily Study Schedule : Take out at least 4-5 hours from your day to prepare for CEED 2026 examination. Make it a daily habit so that there is no burden at the last moment.

Understand the CEED 2026 Exam Pattern: To make a proper study strategy for CEED 2026, one must be aware of CEED exam topics, its pattern, and the marking criteria. Shiksha makes it easy to get it all in one place.

Visit CEED Official Site regularly: Stay updated about the CEED dates, the latest changes in exam patterns, or other important factors by visiting the official site for CEED https://ceedapp.iitb.ac.in.

Join Online CEED Crash Courses: Various design institutes are offering online CEED courses and live 3-month CEED classes under a pocket-friendly budget. One may join these to pump up the CEED 2026 preparations.

Practise CEED Previous Year’s Exam Papers: Visit CEED official site and download last year’s PDF question papers. Practice as many question papers as you can. This will help you to make a mindful time management plan to solve the CEED 2026 exam.

Get CEED Mock Test Series or Sample Papers: Candidates should practice CEED self-mock tests , solved sample paper PDF and online tests. It helps to create a better study plan, opens up your mind and strengthens inner confidence to clear the entrance exam.

faqs.question: What is the procedure for preparing the CEED 2026 result?
faqs.answer: Result of CEED 2026 is prepared by giving weightage to CEED Part A and Part B. Part A will carry 25% marks. Part B will carry 75% marks. Final score is calculated using a formula. CEED Final Score = 0.25 x Marks obtained in Part A + 0.75 x Marks obtained in Part B. CEED result will be out on March 04, 2026 on the website.

You can't use for admission in the next year. Likewise, you can't use CEED 2025 scores for admission in the upcoming session.

faqs.question: Do mock tests and CEED sample papers have the sample role?
faqs.answer: No, mock tests are not the same as CEED question or sample papers. It is because the main purpose of the mock tests is to help the candidate get acquainted with the exam pattern and system, especially if the exam is conducted in an online mode. The mocks will allow the candidate get accustomed with the exam mode, navigation, scoring, and answering patterns. To some extent it also may help the candidate improve problem-solving and time-managment skills, which are typically the exclusive domain of CEED sample papers. Additionally, mock tests are meant to be taken in the last few days of the exam. On the other hand, sample papers are typically solved even in the early stages of exam preparation.

faqs.question: Is CEED a national-level exam?
faqs.answer: Yes, CEED is a national-level exam for admission to M.Des and PhD courses offered by participating colleges. The exam is conducted by IIT Bombay. In addition to the participating colleges, a number of other institutes, known as result-sharing institutes, will also use CEED scores for admission purposes. The CEED 2026 exam will be conducted on Janaury 18, 2026. The application form the exam is currently open.

blocks.value: In CEED scorecard and merit list, ranks are allotted to candidates in different categories. Check out the different types of CEED ranks that are allotted to candidates:

value: Open Rank : Open rank is given to candidates whose total CEED score and marks in Part-A are equal to or more than the minimum qualifying marks

EWS Rank : This rank is given to General category candidates who belong to the Economically Weaker Section (EWS) of the society. Such candidates are also given Open ranks as there is no separate cutoff for such candidates.

SC/ST/OBC-NCL Rank : This rank is given to candidates who belong to Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST) and Other Backward Class (OBC) categories. However, the ranks of such candidates are retained only if they are able to produce original certificates issued by the relevant authority at the time of verification of documents. If any candidate fails to produce the relevant document, s/he is considered under Open category only.

Open PwD Rank : This rank is valid for General category candidates who are physically disabled. However, similar to SC/ST/OBC-NCL rank, candidates can retain the Open Persons with Disability (PwD) rank only if they are able to produce relevant documents at the time of verification of documents.

SC/ST/OBC-NCL PwD Rank : This rank is valid for SC/ST/OBC category candidates who are physically disabled. If any candidate fails to produce the relevant document at the time of verification, s/he will be considered for admission as per their SC/ST/OBC rank or Open rank, as applicable.

But note that in this case, scorecard will only include qualifying status and Part A marks. Part B marks, Total marks and merit ranks will only be issued to qualified candidates. Candidates who have been assigned a merit rank can participate in the counseling process conducted by participating institutes.

faqs.question: When will the scorecard of CEED 2026 be released?
faqs.answer: IIT Bombay will release the scorecard for the CEED 2026 exam on March 10, 2026; the last date to download the scorecard is June 11, 2026. The scorecard will be released after CEED 2026 results are declared. The results are schedule to be declared on March 5, 2026. To download the scorecard, go to the CEED 2026 exam portal, and log in by entering your email id and password. IIT Bombay will not send hard copies of the score card to candidates.

faqs.question: When will the CEED 2026 result be declared?
faqs.answer: IIT Bombay will declare results of CEED 2026 on March 04, 2026. It will be declared online at ceed.iitb.ac.in. To check results, candidate needs to log in to the result portals using their login ID. CEED 2026 results will be released for all candidates who appear in the design entrance exam. However, the CEED 2026 merit rank will only be issued to candidates who qualify for Part A and are shortlisted.

faqs.question: Can I download the CEED 2026 scorecard at the time of the declaration of exam results?
faqs.answer: The results of CEED 2026 will be declared on March 4, 2026. Meanwhile, the scorecard will be available for download from March 10, 2026 (onward). So, you won’t be able to download the scorecard at the time of declaration of CEED 2026 results. The scorecard will be released online at the CEED 2026 - IIT Bombay admission portal - ceed.iitb.ac.in. You can download the scorecard by logging into the scorecard-download portal using your email id and password. In case of candidates who have qualified Part A, the CEED 2026 scorecard will include details like Part A & Part B marks, Open and category-wise merit ranks.

faqs.question: When will the CEED 2026 exam analysis be released?
faqs.answer: The exam analysis for CEED 2026 exam is updated at shiksha.com/design/industrial-product-design/ceed-exam-analysis. The article covers the detailed analysis of the exam. This includes the types of questions asked, sectional and overall difficulty level, topic-wise weightage, specific questions asked, etc. IIT Bombay conducted the CEED 2026 exam on January 18, 2026 (9 am - 12 noon). Our representatives visited the exam centre and brought you student reaction and exam analysis. The analysis will update you in case there are any technical issues faced by candidates during the exam.

faqs.question: Will IIT Bombay also release the list of toppers along with the CEED 2026 scorecard?
faqs.answer: The scorecard of CEED 2026 will be released on March 10, 2026. IIT Bombay will also release the name of the toppers sometime thereabout. The details will be released in the form of a press release. In the 2023 edition of the exam, the CEED exam was topped by Ms. Khyati Rathor, who scored 68.85 marks out of 100 marks. The press release would also include other stats like the number of candidates who registered for, appeared in and qualified the CEED exam. The gender-wise breakdown will also be given. A total of 4,910 candidates appeared in the CEED 2026 exam.

faqs.question: Can I use the CEED 2026  scorecard for admission to result-sharing institutes?
faqs.answer: The result-sharing institutes of CEED 2026 will allocate some of their M.Des seats for CEED 2026 qualified candidates. However, these institutes may also use scores of other entrance exam for admission purposes. So, if you have qualified CEED 2026, you can apply to these institutes. Note that there will be no joint counseling for the result-sharing institutes. So, you need to apply directly to the institute you are seeking admission to.

faqs.question: Can I use the CEED 2026 score card as a proof of date of birth?
faqs.answer: The scorecard for CEED 2026 is meant only for admission to the M.Des program offered by participating and result-sharing institutes. It cannot be used as a proof of birth. Further, the scorecard will also not be a legal document that can be used as a category or disability certificate. Also, note that the scorecard of CEED 2026 will be valid only for a period of one year. So, if the candidate doesn’t take admission within that one-year period, the CEED 2026 scorecard will no longer be valid for admission purposes.

faqs.question: What is the last date to download the scorecard of CEED 2026?
faqs.answer: IIT Bombay will release the scorecard for CEED 2026 on March 10, 2026. It can be downloaded till July 31, 2026. Scorecards will be availble on the webiste of CEED.

faqs.question: What aspects will be covered by CEED 2026 exam analysis?
faqs.answer: The analysis of the CEED 2026 exam will be available after the exam. The exam analysis covers points given below. Sectional difficulty - The difficulty level will be evaluated on three scales, easy, moderate, and difficult. Overall difficulty - It will take into account the sectional difficulty as well as the difficulty level of the exam over the years. The weightage of questions - It will examine the number of questions asked from the various topics. Good attempts - This will showcase the minimum number of questions you are expected to attempt to have a chance at admission. Expected cut-off - Both Part A cut-off and admission cut-off would be covered.

CEED Entrance Exam will consist of two parts.
1. Part A
2. Part B

Along with the syllabus, the candidate must also consult the CEED exam pattern , as it will define the test structure, section-wise questions, and marking scheme. CEED 2026 subject-wise Syllabus
The syllabus is outlined in the CEED information brochure. The syllabus for CEED 2026 for both Part A and Part B is given in the tables below.
CEED 2026 Part A Syllabus
The CEED Syllabus for Part A is to have the following topics:

value: Ability to visualize and transform 2D shapes and 3D objects and their spatial relationships.
Know-how of scientific principles and everyday objects.
Capacity to detect concealed properties in day-to-day life and think critically about them. Attention to detail, classification, analysis, inference, and prediction.
General awareness of environmental, social, and cultural connections with design.
Ability to analyze qualitative and quantitative information.
Proficiency in reading and comprehending Standard English.
Grasp of verbal and non-verbal analogies, metaphors, signs, and symbols.
Awareness about art/artifact/product, artists/designers, art/design history, and trends.
Knowledge of media, materials, production processes, and ergonomics.

blocks.value: CEED 2026 Part B Syllabus

value: Ability to draw products, people, or scenes in proportion with good line quality, composition, proportion, perspective, and shading.
Capacity to think out-of-the-box and come up with unique as well as diverse solutions.
Skills to communicate concepts and ideas clearly with the help of text and visuals.
Capability to understand the user and the context, knowledge of properties of materials, and their appropriate use in design.

blocks.value: The marking scheme for CEED Part B.

Note: Given that CEED will be an aptitude test, no books are recommended by exam officials for preparation. Nevertheless, the candidate is recommended to practice their drawing, rendering, and visualization skills. In addition, previous years' question papers could be a good source of material to prepare for CEED 2026.
Focus more on Part B of the CEED 2026 question paper

The CEED 2026 final score will be calculated by giving 25% weightage to Part A, and 75% weightage to Part B. So, when preparing for the exam, the candidate has to pay THREE times more attention to Part B.

faqs.question: Is CEED a tough entrance exam?
faqs.answer: The difficulty level of CEED exam is maintained by authorities over the years. However, most design aspirants share that if the difficulty level of all design entrance exams conducted for PG level courses is compared then CEED is slightly easier than the NID Entrance Exam . This is primarily because the drawing questions asked in NID DAT are considered to be tougher than those put forth in the CEED exam.

faqs.question: Is CEED a computer-based exam?
faqs.answer: CEED 2026 will have two parts - Part A and Part B. Part A will be conducted as a computer-based test. Part B will be conducted offline . Candidate will be provided answer booklets by the invigilator, where they have enter their answers. After the exam, candidate has to return the answer booklets of Part B to the invigilator. Part B answer booklets will only be checked if the candidate qualfiies Part A. Final score of CEED 2026 will be calculated by giving weightage to Part A and Part B.

faqs.question: What is the weightage of CEED Part B exam?
faqs.answer: CEED Part B is of 100 marks . They will have to attempt questions related to Drawing, Creativity, Communication, and Problem Solving. Part B carries 75% weightage. Exam will check ability of candidate to draw products, people, scenes, etc., and also their capability to understand user and context.

faqs.question: What is the weightage of CEED Part A exam?
faqs.answer: The weightage of CEED Part A is 25%. Candidates have to attempt 44 questions in CEED Part A. It includes MSQs, MCQs, and NAT questions. Total marks for CEED Part A is 150.

faqs.question: Can I prepare for CEED without coaching?
faqs.answer: It is very much possible to prepare for CEED without coaching. If you prepare for the exam on your own, you need to be serious and plan the preparation smartly. After going through the syllabus, you must be able to decide the difficulty level, the time it will take to cover the syllabus, and revise. Remember, there are many instances of toppers who managed to ace the CEED exam without the aid of any coaching. Further, the outcome may not depend on whether you do coaching or not, but on the quality of your preparation.

Find your weak areas for the exam and work to improve those areas/subjects Take mock tests.

faqs.question: What should I do if I am not able to complete a particular topic from the CEED 2026 syllabus?

faqs.question: How can I develop my drawing skills for CEED?
faqs.answer: Sketching part of CEED will include representation, in the form of geometric figures like lines, squares, and triangles, outline drawing, detailing, and shading. Try outline drawing, representation, focus on detailing and shading. Also try shape of the figure, proportion and line quality.

faqs.question: Will the question paper include questions from all the topics mentioned in CEED 2026 syllabus?

So, the candidate can’t skip any topics when preparing for CEED. The candidate is urged to go through the previous years' question papers to get an idea about the paper structure and types of questions asked. That being said, keep in mind that the syllabus has been revised for CEED.
